newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile Jan-Nov copper output up 24 pct on 1995.
newsitem.headline: Chile Jan-Nov copper output up 24 pct on 1995.

text.p: Chile's copper output climbed 24 percent in the first 11 months of last year to 2.8 million tonnes from 2.26 million tonnes in the same period 1995, said state copper studies center Comision Chilena del Cobre.
Production of refined copper using new, low-cost heapleaching technology climbed 70 percent over the January-November period to 562,600 tonnes, said the report.
The figures showed copper output from traditional smelters and refineries fell 1.5 percent to 1 million tonnes.
Blister output rose 33 percent to 201,300 tonnes, while the production of copper in concentrates increased 37 percent to 1.03 million tonnes.
Molybdenum production fell five percent over the period to 15,580 tonnes.
